title: CloudTrail + Config + Access Analyzer
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Scenario → best service → why not the others. Answer without night-5-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×3 D×2 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: A security team needs to investigate which IAM user deleted an S3 object from a production bucket three days ago. Which service should they use first?

options.A: AWS CloudTrail — API activity history with caller, time, and source IP
options.B: AWS Config — current resource configuration state and compliance rules
options.C: Amazon GuardDuty — threat findings from VPC Flow, DNS, and CloudTrail
options.D: AWS Security Hub — aggregated severity-scored findings across accounts

questions.question: You need continuous evaluation of whether any S3 bucket in the account currently allows public read access. Which service is purpose-built for this?

options.A: AWS CloudTrail — records when bucket policies changed, not continuous state
options.B: Amazon GuardDuty — detects threats, not configuration compliance posture
options.C: AWS Config managed rule — evaluates current public-read bucket policy state
options.D: IAM Access Analyzer — maps external access paths, not continuous Config rules

questions.question: A company with 20 AWS accounts needs a single dashboard showing Config compliance status across all accounts and regions. What is the best approach?

options.A: Enable a multi-Region CloudTrail trail separately in each member account
options.B: Enable GuardDuty detectors in the management account only for org coverage
options.C: Turn on IAM Access Analyzer organization-wide without a Config aggregator
options.D: AWS Config aggregator — collect compliance from accounts and regions in one view

questions.question: An auditor requires proof that CloudTrail log files have not been tampered with after delivery to S3. Which CloudTrail feature addresses this?

options.A: Multi-Region trail — expands Region coverage but does not prove delivered log integrity
options.B: Log file validation — digest files with hashes to verify delivered log integrity
options.C: Data event logging — records object-level S3 API calls, not tamper proof
options.D: CloudTrail Insights — flags unusual API activity volume, not file integrity

questions.question: You discover an S3 bucket policy that grants s3:GetObject to Principal "*". Which tool identifies whether this resource is accessible from outside your AWS account?

options.A: AWS Config — flags public read via rules but does not map external principals
options.B: AWS CloudTrail — shows past API calls, not who can access via the policy
options.C: Amazon Inspector — scans EC2/ECR for CVEs, not S3 resource policy exposure
options.D: IAM Access Analyzer — evaluates resource policies for external/cross-account access

questions.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes CloudTrail and AWS Config?

options.A: CloudTrail records resource configuration; Config records API call history exclusively
options.B: CloudTrail records API activity; Config records configuration history and compliance
options.C: Both services require GuardDuty to be enabled before they can collect any data
options.D: Config replaces CloudTrail entirely for IAM audit and API accountability needs

questions.question: An EC2 instance is communicating with a known command-and-control IP address. Which service would most likely generate this finding?

options.A: AWS Config — evaluates configuration compliance, not malicious network behavior
options.B: AWS CloudTrail — logs management API calls, not C2 traffic to external IPs
options.C: Amazon GuardDuty — ML threat detection using VPC Flow, DNS, and CloudTrail
options.D: AWS Config rule IAM_USER_MFA_ENABLED — checks MFA, not network C2 indicators

questions.question: You want a unified view of findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, and Config in one place with severity scoring. Which service should you enable?

options.A: AWS Security Hub — aggregates and prioritizes findings from multiple security services
options.B: AWS CloudTrail — API audit log only; not a multi-service severity findings dashboard
options.C: Amazon CloudWatch — metrics and logs; not a cross-service security findings hub
options.D: AWS Config aggregator alone — compliance view, not full severity-scored findings

questions.question: A team wants automated malware scanning of EBS volumes attached to EC2 instances when suspicious behavior is detected. Which GuardDuty feature addresses this?

options.A: GuardDuty Malware Protection for EC2 — scans EBS volumes from threat findings
options.B: GuardDuty S3 Protection — monitors object-level S3 API activity for threats
options.C: AWS Config managed rule — continuous configuration compliance, not malware scans
options.D: IAM Access Analyzer — external access findings, not EBS volume malware scanning

questions.question: After enabling AWS Config, a static-site bucket is NON_COMPLIANT on S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED, but the site works via CloudFront. What is the most accurate interpretation?

options.A: The site is compromised — CloudFront is serving malicious content from the public bucket
options.B: Config is broken because CloudFront origins must always use public bucket policies
options.C: Bucket allows public read, failing the rule; private bucket + OAC restores compliance
options.D: CloudTrail will automatically rewrite the bucket policy overnight to restore compliance
